Implement Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, retention labels, and data loss prevention policies within SharePoint and OneDrive as authored by Information Security and Compliance. Support eDiscovery, legal hold, and records retention requests in coordination with Legal and Compliance. Maintain documented administrative procedures, control narratives, and platform architecture documentation. Operate all administrative access through the Bank’s privileged access management tooling, using separate administrative credentials and just-in-time elevation. Stakeholder Engagement Partner with business unit content owners to design site structures that support their workflows within governance constraints. Deliver enablement and training for site owners on permissions, sharing, and records handling responsibilities. Contribute collaboration platform input to the Architecture Review Board and to enterprise data governance forums. Working knowledge of Entra ID role-based access control, conditional access, and privileged identity management concepts. Treats permissions and retention as control obligations rather than service requests. Operational discipline. Grantek is a recognized leading provider of integrated automation, smart manufacturing and industrial information solutions in the global marketplace. Our clients are some of the worlds most respected Fortune 100 companies and recognized consumer brands: Mondelez, Brita, Molson Coors, Coca-Cola, Kraft-Heinz, to name a few. We offer an atmosphere where you can express your creative ideas and talents by working on a variety of projects and technologies. Using today’s leading edge technology, you will partner with clients to solve their most complex manufacturing and industrial information problems. We offer a competitive and comprehensive compensation package, retirement matching, company paid benefits, flexible work hours, and an education/career development program. The vast majority of our employees have started off their careers at Grantek and have grown into successful senior team members who are integral to our client's manufacturing processes. Strong organizational ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in fast-paced environments. Flexibility for local travel with occasional day trips, and the opportunity for additional travel within India.
